reviews.text:
This is a hamburger restaurant located near Noryangjin Station Line 1.
You can eat a cheeseburger set for 10,900 won.
I had no expectations before eating it,
After eating it, it felt not as bad as I thought.
What I think of as a cheeseburger
It feels a little different, but it tastes just as good as a hamburger.
Balance is better than expected.
The taste of the vegetables is not too overpowering.
You can eat it cleaner than you think without feeling greasy.
The French fries have a crispy texture and taste.
It goes well with hamburgers.
Drinks are also served in cans so you can enjoy the original taste.

The store is small and there are only a few tables.
Eating at the store can be a bit inconvenient.
As I kept grilling the hamburgers, the heat started to build up.
It's not something that can be covered by the air conditioner.
It's a bit hot to eat at the store in the summer.
You order at the kiosk at the counter.
than the price posted in the store
The actual price calculated is 1,000 won cheaper.
Is it cheaper to buy it at the store?
Sometimes when I pass by and see the store
I was worried because it felt like a delivery specialty store, but
When eaten at an actual store, it is a handmade burger restaurant.
It was better than I thought because I could feel it.

Well-balanced hamburger~

My first visit to Dokki, which I had only heard about. This is a place that people who are serious about tteokbokki will enjoy.
However, for people like me who are visiting for the first time, it can be confusing to know how to eat.
Literally a tteokbokki buffet, all the ingredients for tteokbokki are placed in small portions on each tray. Just take a large bowl on the table, put a lot of rice cakes, onions, green onions, sausages, etc., combine the sauces on the other side, and cook tteokbokki just like you would shabu-shabu. reviews.author: Captain Kang
reviews.text: I like YouTuber Shanghai Gi, so I watched him often and looked at this place because I wanted to eat delicious food. I just wanted to visit sometime, and after having a meeting near Noryangjin Station and staying overnight, I visited for lunch the next day. I was thinking about eating gomtang as hangover, but the reviews were really good, so I went there. Since the meal started at 11 o'clock, I waited for about 10 minutes, picked up the tray, put the food in it, and went down to the basement and picked up the spoon. The soup is only about half a bowl, which is not even enough to serve as hangover... too little. If you look at the previous photo, I saw that it was poured into a large bowl. I think they use the hindquarters part of the boiled pork because it is so dry. It doesn't really suit me, who often goes to sushi restaurants or buffet restaurants. When I was young, I tried a goshi restaurant in Sillim-dong for several years, but it wasn't like this. I left everything I ate. I felt really sorry for my friend who went with me. I regret eating some ramen or boiled fruit. Looking at the blog, I see that the boss has changed.

reviews.author: Olivia Kwon
reviews.text:
I ordered pizza, rose pasta and sangria.

1. It is good if the dough is thin and crispy because it is baked in an oven.
So the pizza is edible, but the ingredients are very poor and the tomato paste in the pizza feels like canned paste.

2 The pasta noodles were cooked moderately well.
The rose pasta was so sweet I thought it had soy milk in it.
It feels like pink sauce mixed with soy milk cream?
It was shrimp rose cream pasta... but it didn't taste like that at all.

3 And the sangria...isn't refreshing and fresh.
Too little wine was added
It feels like it was made with old or leftover house wine.
It seems old enough to be sour.
If you tell me that it tastes like that because it is aged, I have nothing to say.
If I was going to pay that much for that sangria, I should have just had a glass of cold water.

It was so hot today that I didn't want to eat home-cooked food, so I ate it for now.
I won't go again next time
Even though I spent a week in Italy eating only pizza and pasta, I didn't feel bad. I felt it right after eating dinner today.

Lastly, I left today after speaking to the store owner.
Check your hygiene

While looking for a chicken and beer restaurant, I looked at about 10 chicken restaurants and was exhausted and just before I gave up, I saw a sign and thought it was the last restaurant and went in. The antique interior looks like a Gyeongyang restaurant. I was surprised when I first picked up and ate the popcorn, was surprised by the second draft beer (Terra), and fainted when I tasted the third chicken. We fry and make all the popcorn and chicken radish ourselves. Draft beer is created sweet and delicious through the care and hands of craftsmen, including the temperature and pressure of the can, expiration date, temperature of the glass, and tap extraction technology. It's smooth on the throat and has a nice scent at the end. Chicken, this is serious. Secret fried batter and secret cured chicken aged for a day. Chicken skin combined with fried batter provides a crispy and fragrant taste. The perfection is so high that it is sold separately as a snack. The chicken doesn't have any soggy grease at all and even though the meat is dry, it looks moist and juicy. It's been a million years since the two of us ate a whole chicken. It is a friendly and craftsmanship place. Recommended~^^
